svg.title: Ila silently weighs the funding, grievance ledger and unsigned trial form.
svg.desc: Ila sits over the red ledger, where blank tabs mark clinic, drainage and grievance needs. Her pen lies beside the activation line while Vale stands back and waits for her decision.
